presentation.label: MASTER SUITE
presentation.summary: A filter and a 4-band EQ on the master mix, with fast press-and-turn editing. Work in progress: not yet wired to the unit.
presentation.overview: Master Suite is the first stage of a mastering chain for the Digitone: a filter (high-pass, low-pass or band-pass with resonance) and a 4-band EQ (low shelf, two bells, high shelf, plus or minus 15 dB) on the master mix. The DSP is written in fixed point and tested on a computer against reference responses. It does not yet run on a Digitone: the page, its drawing and the address of the master mix still have to be filled in from the owner's own OS 1.44.
highlights: Filter: cutoff 20 Hz to 18 kHz, resonance 0-127, HP/LP/BP, on/off.
EQ: low shelf, low-mid bell, high-mid bell and high shelf, each plus or minus 15 dB in 0.5 dB steps.
Exact bypass: a flat EQ and an off filter leave the audio untouched, bit for bit.
Press and turn a knob for a coarse step.
usage: Not usable on a unit yet. See TESTING.md, open items.

access.location: Planned: one mod page after the External Mixer pages, with FILTER and EQ sub-pages (not yet wired).
steps: Not yet wired to the unit's pages. The control layout below is the design.

controls.name: FILTER E
controls.doc: Cutoff, 20 Hz to 18 kHz in 128 log steps. Press and turn for steps of 8.

controls.name: FILTER F
controls.doc: Resonance 0-127 (Q 0.5 to 12, quadratic). Press and turn for steps of 8.

controls.name: FILTER G
controls.doc: Filter type: HP, LP or BP, 12 dB per octave.

controls.name: FILTER H
controls.doc: Filter on or off. Off is an exact bypass.

controls.name: EQ A-D
controls.doc: Gain of the low shelf, low-mid bell, high-mid bell and high shelf, -15 to +15 dB in 0.5 dB steps. Press and turn for 2 dB steps. 0 dB bypasses the band exactly.

controls.name: EQ F
controls.doc: Low-mid bell frequency, 200 Hz to 2.5 kHz (Q fixed at 1).

controls.name: EQ G
controls.doc: High-mid bell frequency, 600 Hz to 7 kHz (Q fixed at 1).

limitations: Work in progress: the module is silent. It processes nothing until the master mix address and block size from OS 1.44 are filled in (src/main.c).
The page, its drawing and the knob and encoder events are not written.
Assumes 48 kHz and signed 32-bit stereo samples; both are unverified on a unit.
No unit or emulator test has been run. The DSP was tested on a computer only.
Settings are not saved with the project yet.
The ColdFire link may need libgcc for 64-bit multiplication; this was not tried.

load.conditions: Estimate from a host build (x86 code, tables, state). Measure on the unit with the filter on and all four EQ bands away from 0 dB.

tests.summary: DSP and control model pass 576,078 host checks (coefficient and end-to-end accuracy, bypass, stability, settling, sweep, DC, ranges). Nothing was built for the ColdFire, flashed or run in an emulator.

license.declaration: Original work by the author and Claude. No third-party DSP code; the filter and EQ use the published RBJ biquad formulas. No stock firmware data.
